meta.description: Registry for formal failure modes encountered during proof verification.

failure_modes.name: unresolved_operator_dependency
failure_modes.description: A proof step relies on an operator with undefined or unregistered behavior.

failure_modes.name: unverified_equivalence_property
failure_modes.description: A proof step assumes reflexivity, symmetry, or transitivity for an unverified equivalence relation.

failure_modes.name: unbounded_quantifier_scope
failure_modes.description: A proof uses universal or existential quantifiers without explicit formal bounds.

failure_modes.name: unclassified_boundary_failure
failure_modes.description: A proof fails to explicitly account for a classified boundary or edge case.

failure_modes.name: logical_trace_inconsistency
failure_modes.description: The symbolic trace in formal_verification.json contradicts the prose in proof.md.

failure_modes.name: implicit_promotion_attempt
failure_modes.description: Verification scaffold attempts to promote theorem status without satisfying all obligations.
